errors.text_span: 蓝色曲线代表每日新增患者人数，绿色柱状图代表有关COVID-19的新闻报道数目
errors.evidence: According to the figure legend, the blue-green bars represent '该日全球确诊数量' (daily global confirmed cases) and the blue line represents '有关covid-19新闻数量' (COVID-19 news counts). The machine description swaps the mappings.
The x-axis labels are shown at weekly intervals, not daily tick marks.
The description says the chart uses color and a legend, but it omits that the x-axis labels are displayed at weekly intervals, as shown in the figure and reference.
The description does not mention that the plot is a dual-axis chart combining bars and a line, which is a key structural feature visible in the figure.
